option.fly-speed-modifier.full_range.too: When disabled, the effective maximum multiplier is limited to 20.00x. When enabled, the effective maximum is 100.00x.
option.fly-speed-modifier.max_speed.tool: Saved upper bound for the temporary flight speed multiplier.
option.fly-speed-modifier.min_speed.tool: Lower bound for the temporary flight speed multiplier.
Saved multiplier used for the first adjustment and for reset-on-adjust.
option.fly-speed-modifier.reset_on_adjus: When enabled, pressing the adjustment key resets the multiplier to the configured default value. When disabled, the previous multiplier is preserved.
option.fly-speed-modifier.scroll_step.to: Controls how many non-linear multiplier adjustment operations are applied per mouse-wheel unit.
option.fly-speed-modifier.apply_to_other: Also applies the current multiplier to client-controlled movement such as walking, sprinting, swimming, climbing, airborne horizontal movement, and steerable mounts. Jump velocity and natural falling speed are not modified.
